extracted.name: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
extracted.description: Rich, fudgy chocolate brownies with a dense, chewy center and slightly crisp edges. Deep chocolate flavor with a soft melt-in-your-mouth texture that makes them extra gooey and satisfying
ingredient_lines: 3/4 cup chocolate chips or chocolate chunks
instruction_lines: Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Pour the melted butter into Bowl 1.
In Bowl 2, add the all-purpose flour
Add the chocolate chips or chunks.
Fold the chocolate into the batter
Scoop batter onto the baking tray.
The edges should look set while the centers stay soft
Let the brownies cool on the tray before moving them.
